BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   B. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   D. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   C. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

7. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   C. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.

8. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   D. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   B. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   D. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

13. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   C. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.

14. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

16. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   D. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
